Microsoft (MSFT) Shareholder Peak Asset Management Has Cut Its Position; As Sanofi (SNY) Share Value Declined, Beacon Financial Group Boosted Its Holding by $505,723
May 21, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Peak Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 7.26% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Peak Asset Management Llc sold 9,612 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.63% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 122,704 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.50 million, down from 132,316 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Peak Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $740.35 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.19% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $96.36. About 13.92M shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 37.43% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.88% the S&P500.
Beacon Financial Group increased its stake in Sanofi (SNY) by 12.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Beacon Financial Group bought 11,761 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.41% with the market. The institutional investor held 105,488 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.54 million, up from 93,727 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Beacon Financial Group who had been investing in Sanofi for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $96.85 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.03% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $38.88. About 1.30 million shares traded or 10.68% up from the average. Sanofi (NYSE:SNY) has declined 13.31% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.86% the S&P500.
